label: after-3800-real-optimized
measurement_limits: One sample per row; task-worker quiescence is declared separately from external host load.
A failed workflow is not a completed latency baseline; no speed ratio is asserted.
Graph timing and invocation wrappers instrument the MCP service owner only, excluding disposable media children.
Source scans cover only the named wrapped functions, not all filesystem reads.
Full projection convergence, connector overhead, and model planning remain unmeasured unless explicitly populated.

result.connector_overhead_reason: stdio client wall and server ledger are independently measured but not request-correlated

corpus.inventory_omitted_reason: Generated per-page inventory omitted; generator identity, corpus byte count, and corpus SHA-256 retained.

result.full_convergence_reason: graph, lexical, and embedding projection convergence are not publicly proven by this harness

graph_execution_elapsed_ms.semantics: current-epoch values include completed invocations only; active work has no elapsed value until completion

graph_invocations.semantics: current-epoch attempts/completions only; reset-crossing warm-up invocations are reported separately as pre-reset spillover

graph_topology_discovery.coverage: measurement-window observations from EpistemicGraphIndex._sources_linking_to only; vault walk and reads are scoped to that call and can include reset-crossing warm-up work

initial_graph_readiness.reason: managed keyword warm-up does not establish hybrid graph readiness
